description: Private, governed local memory shared by Codex, Claude Code and Claude Desktop.

interface.longDescription: MemorySafe gives Codex twelve governed memory tools: remember, find, forget, restore, protect, explain, review and resolve conflicts, health, diagnostics, and opt-in automatic capture. Memories stay in one SQLite file on this computer, shared with Claude Code and Claude Desktop.
